decisions_made: Default behavior remains rule-based: use_model=False so all existing Avatar/Aide/Simulation behavior is unchanged unless a model is explicitly bound and enabled.

ML dependencies are lazily imported (transformer/torch adapters import torch/transformers only when instantiated), so torch/transformers are NOT hard dependencies — verified `import torch` still fails in the environment.
Adapters are provider-agnostic: OpenAICompatBackend uses base_url + an API key environment variable with stdlib urllib only; no vendor is hardcoded and no secrets are committed to code.
Training is opt-in: enabled via model_config / explicit API call (plus optional auto_train flag) — no training happens unless explicitly requested.
Fixed the silent pytest.ini [tool:pytest] -> [pytest] so the 80% coverage gate actually runs in CI (previously pytest ignored the mislabeled section and the gate was dead).
